requirement: Installer-built Joomla quickstarts are owed the showcase phase, and a phase that left every owner as it was settles failed

oracle.ref: PR #1685 (fix); fix evidence: Dev matrix after #1674: JA Fresco j6 built through the installer kept its showcase (no receipt); JA Diner wp7 logged applied while every navigation was a conflict
oracle.invariant: S1: every named test passes: an installer-shaped quickstart this run builds writes the receipt and the bind runs the phase; a resumed build keeps its request id; a re-run on a built site is not owed the phase; a status whose skipped object names every owner as left settles the phase failed, not applied.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: owners the status leaves as they were are named; all of them left is a failed phase, not applied
an installer-shaped quickstart this run builds is owed its showcase phase, and the bind runs it
an installer-shaped quickstart resumed before its build finished keeps the request id it was given
a re-run on an installer-shaped site already built is not owed the phase, and says so
